guideline: assigned harmfulness tags to the alternatives generated by each system, focusing on instances not covered by automatic metrics, using defined harmful tags: Grammar Error, Change of Meaning, More Difficult, Gibberish.
Annotators evaluated each generated alternative using four harmfulness tags: Grammar Error, Change of Meaning, More Difficult, and Gibberish.

Taking into account the standard human evaluation criteria of fluency, adequacy, and simplicity in TS, we defined the following four harmful tags: • Grammar Error: The alternative is grammatically incorrect, including inflection, and conjugation errors. • Change of Meaning: Replacing the target with the alternative drastically changes the meaning of context. • More Difficult: The alternative is clearly more difficult than the target, even though it preserves the meaning to some extent. • Gibberish: The alternative does not make sense at all.
